subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw pursue a new Channel Broker SDK/plugin boundary for shared channel conformance, or should this reliability work stay within the existing channel-outbound contract?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested broker surface, but the previous implementation stack was closed because it crossed channel, plugin SDK, runtime, config, and security boundaries without an approved design.

options.title: Approve a narrow broker design first
options.body: Define the minimal broker SDK/plugin/security boundary in a design issue, then accept a focused conformance-harness PR against that boundary.

options.title: Extend channel-outbound instead
options.body: Keep the existing channel-outbound lifecycle contract as canonical and add only the missing generic conformance coverage there.

options.title: Reject the broker direction
options.body: Close the remaining broker trackers and ask for channel-specific reliability fixes or ClawHub/plugin experiments instead.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow broker design first
recommendation.body: Define the minimal broker SDK/plugin/security boundary in a design issue, then accept a focused conformance-harness PR against that boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the live product/API boundary decision on the linked Channel Broker PR stack.
